simulation_requirement: Simulate how key actors react to a crisis around the Eternal Forge.

actors.name: Aria Flameheart
actors.summary: Born under the crimson eclipse, Aria was destined for greatness from her first breath. As the youngest Forge Master in a thousand years, she possesses an innate understanding of the cosmic flames that power creation itself. Her mentor, the ancient smith Valorian, recognized her potential when she was merely five years old, reforging a broken legendary blade with nothing but raw determination and intuition. Now, at twenty-three, she stands as guardian of the Eternal Forge, tasked with maintaining the balance between creation and destruction while dark forces seek to corrupt the forge's power for their own ends.

actors.name: Valorian the Eternal
actors.summary: The oldest living being in the Eternal Forge, Valorian has witnessed the rise and fall of countless civilizations over his ten thousand year existence. His true origins are lost to time, though legends speak of him being forged directly from the first flames of creation. As a master smith and teacher, he has trained generations of Forge Masters, each one carefully selected for their potential and moral character. His weathered face bears the scars of a thousand battles, and his eyes hold the wisdom of ages. Despite his immense power, Valorian chooses to work in the shadows, guiding rather than ruling, knowing that true strength comes from nurturing others rather than dominating them.

context_locations.name: The Eternal Forge
context_locations.description: The heart of creation itself, a massive forge where reality is shaped. The forge burns with cosmic flames that never die, powered by the energies of creation. Ancient anvils line the workshop, each one capable of crafting artifacts of immense power.

context_locations.name: Forge Master's House
context_locations.description: A sturdy stone house near the Eternal Forge, serving as living quarters for the Forge Masters. The walls are lined with ancient tomes and blueprints. A warm hearth keeps the dwelling comfortable despite the cosmic flames outside.

context_locations.name: Storage Chest in Master's House
context_locations.description: An ornate wooden chest reinforced with mythril bands. Contains valuable tools, rare materials, and personal effects of the Forge Masters. The lock is enchanted to open only for authorized individuals.

context_locations.name: Tool Barn
context_locations.description: A large barn adjacent to the Forge Master's House, filled with smithing tools, raw materials, and unfinished projects. The air smells of metal and oil.

context_locations.name: Crystal Temple
context_locations.description: An ancient temple built by the Crystal Guardians, its walls made of translucent crystal that refracts light into rainbow patterns. The temple serves as a sanctuary and meeting place for those who protect ancient artifacts.

event_seeds.name: The Great Reforging
event_seeds.description: A cataclysmic event where Aria and Valorian must work together to reforge the Cosmic Anchor, the artifact that holds reality together. As dimensional rifts threaten to tear the Eternal Forge apart, they race against time to complete the most ambitious smithing project ever attempted.

world_rules.name: World Context: Eternal Forge
world_rules.text: A realm where reality itself bends to the will of master craftsmen. The Eternal Forge burns at the heart of existence, capable of creating or destroying entire dimensions. Ancient smiths guard its secrets, passing knowledge through generations of devoted apprentices.
